primary: Conditioned minus image-only performance at each predeclared budget on unseen validation class combinations.
aggregation: Equal tasks and equal class sides within each task, then equal images within class. Average fixed training seeds or random-mask seeds before image resampling.
uncertainty: Paired image-cluster bootstrap of weighted numerator/denominator totals. Intervals condition on these tasks and seeds. Bonferroni intervals cover the 2 predeclared budgets separately for each metric, not all metrics jointly.

config.prompt_template: a photo of a {class_name}, a type of flower.

49.cost_scope: These are recorded source-run costs. A reused source can contain additional earlier conditions; do not treat these totals as new per-budget compute or deployment latency.
